assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome, raising concern for intermittent high-grade atrioventricular block or severe bradycardia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
